notes: State check (read-only diagnosis): `npx tsc --noEmit` passes clean (exit 0). `npx oxlint` = 0 errors + 1 intentional pre-existing no-control-regex warning at lib/doctor.ts:38 (ANSI stripping) — matches PLAN.md exactly. `npx vitest run` = 171 passed, 1 skipped, 1 FAILED: tests/doctor.test.ts:55 "runDoctor > never throws even if a probe fails" times out at 5000ms. Findings: (1) tsc/oxlint claims OK — `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` exits 0, zero errors; bare `npx tsc --noEmit` works via cmd too. oxlint 0 errors + 1 pre-existing no-control-regex warning in lib/doctor.ts. (2) STALE EVIDENCE: PLAN.md says 156 tests / 13 files; reality is 171 tests / 15 files (cli.test.ts adds 5, live.test.ts 1 skipped). (3) REAL FLAKE/BUG: `npm test` full run FAILED once — tests/cli.test.ts "agent x without a key" hung 60s and was killed (status -1, expected 1). Passes in isolation (11.5s). Root cause = resource contention: cli.test.ts spawns `npx tsx` 7x (1 probe + 5 tests, tools spawns twice) and 15 vitest files run in parallel; ~2-3s CPU per tsx boot; 60s spawnSync timeout occasionally exceeded on Windows → SIGKILL (-1). Fix direction: raise TIMEOUT_MS, serialize/fork-pool-1 or limit vitest pool, reuse one spawn (cache help probe / tools result), or reduce spawns. PLAN.md §4/§9 evidence table needs refresh to 171 tests/15 files.

Verified gate on current tree (HEAD d44d5bb): `npx oxlint` exit 0 (1 pre-existing intentional warning lib/doctor.ts:38 ANSI stripping) · `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0 · `npx vitest run` exit 0 = 15 files passed + 1 skipped, 217 tests passed + 1 skipped. CORRECTION to the earlier note in state.json: that note claimed tests/doctor.test.ts:55 was the failing test at 171 tests. That does NOT match observed reality and is superseded. The real (earlier) red was tests/cli.test.ts "agent x without a key" — it hung to the 60s spawn timeout (status -1, not 1) because the CLI calls loadDotenv() and the repo has a real .env with a live DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, so the child made a billed network call. Root cause = non-hermetic CLI test. Fix (already present in current tree by a concurrent process): tests/cli.test.ts now sets env.ZOO_NO_DOTENV='1' (the opt-out that already exists in lib/dotenv.ts), and vitest.config.ts sets fileParallelism:false to remove npx-tsx spawn contention; tests/cli.test.ts also grew to 10 tests with signal-aware expectExit(). New since my first read: lib/policy.ts (execution policy engine), tests/policy.test.ts (32 tests), --exec-policy/--allow-exec/--no-exec flags, `mock-run:` mock directive. Lesson: this workspace is being modified concurrently by another process — re-read files before editing, and never trust a tool result that returns assistant-style narrative instead of raw stdout.
